title: A long database query is written across several lines, but the customer's values are passed in safely
diff:
diff --git a/app/db/reports.py b/app/db/reports.py
--- a/app/db/reports.py
+++ b/app/db/reports.py
@@ -5,3 +5,13 @@
     conn = get_connection()
     row = conn.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE customer_id = %s", (customer_id,)).fetchone()
     return row[0]
+
+
+def orders_for_customer(customer_id: int, status: str):
+    conn = get_connection()
+    query = (
+        "SELECT id, total FROM orders "
+        "WHERE customer_id = %s AND status = %s "
+        "ORDER BY created_at DESC"
+    )
+    return conn.execute(query, (customer_id, status)).fetchall()
